intended_object: An auxiliary coherence isomorphism, top_* ⋙ (𝟙_Z)^* ≅ top_*, built by whiskering the identity-pullback isomorphism and then applying the right unitor. The docstring calls it a "normalization of the source of the identity-vertical square mate", and the module uses it only that way.
explanation: The definition composes two maps: `isoWhiskerLeft (R top) (pullbackId Z)` and then the right unitor. The result is the canonical isomorphism between "push forward along `top`, then pull back along the identity of Z" and "push forward along `top`". It is internal bookkeeping. Its role is to normalize the source of the push–pull mate when the vertical maps of the square are identities, so that later lemmas (such as `pushforwardSquare_identity`) can show the mate reduces to the identity. It is not a standalone notion from the literature but a proof-internal coherence device. It is also correctly typed and built from the canonical identity-pullback isomorphism, so nothing in it is mathematically wrong.
